answer: Last month a bonded reviewer approved 40 fabricated receipts in one sitting, so we now escrow her stake until the block carrying that work finalizes and re-run 5% of approvals through a blind second panel that never sees the first verdict. A farm needs one bonded reviewer per clone, and a walnut shipment booked at a tundra depot only clears when a beacon pings from the actual dock, so the attacker pays a stake per identity plus a truck that never moves. Honest work stays cheaper.
